Method of Attack: Previously unknown malware and malicious tool deployed to gain remote access via reverse shells
Used to drop malware and steal data from compromised systems
Later-stage payloads deployed to maintain persistence after initial breach
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Barracuda ESG zero-day vulnerability CVE-2023-2868
Indicators of Compromise: Malware deployment including SeaSpy, Saltwater, SeaSide, Submarine (aka DepthCharge), Whirlpool
